scope: One pre-event predictive law per held-out dated graph. No held-out event or forecast is conditioned on.

training.units: Route delay and running/dwell residual increments in minutes.
training.forecast_sd_rule: Route training departure spread times 60 seconds, with 30-second floor. This bandwidth is not fitted to held-out forecast errors.

dependence: Endpoints of the same trip and date are correlated. Counts are endpoint diagnostics, without an independent-endpoint confidence claim.
interval: Equal-tail conditional-operating 90% intervals of the finite-grid law. Cancellation is scored separately.
